landing.hero.title: The billing panel for game-server hosts.
landing.hero.body: Fluxo sits in front of Pterodactyl. Meter the box, invoice the hour, and keep staff, plugins, and support on one dark ledger—without a second spreadsheet.
landing.hero.cycleDescription: Usage pulled from Wings. Draft invoice, not a CSV dump.
landing.features.title: What the control plane actually does.
landing.features.description: Concrete tools for hosts who run Pterodactyl and still have to send a bill.
landing.features.usage.title: Usage that becomes an invoice
landing.features.usage.description: Meter RAM, disk, and uptime from the node, then close the month as a real invoice—not a spreadsheet of allocations.
landing.features.pterodactyl.title: Pterodactyl, still in charge
landing.features.pterodactyl.description: Provision, suspend, and power Wings servers from Fluxo. The panel stays the source of truth for the box.
landing.features.plugins.title: Plugins for the storefront
landing.features.plugins.description: Sell extra backups, extra ports, or a custom gateway without forking the panel. Hooks stay versioned with your release.
landing.features.staff.title: Staff without shared logins
landing.features.staff.description: Finance, support, and operators get scoped seats. A wipe-weekend suspend does not require the root password.
landing.features.telemetry.title: Telemetry that billing can read
landing.features.telemetry.description: Player hours, idle nodes, and burst RAM roll into the same ledger your customers already see.
landing.features.tickets.title: Tickets tied to the node
landing.features.tickets.description: Support opens on the allocation that failed, with power state and last invoice in the same thread.
landing.plans.title: Price the panel, not the guesswork.
landing.plans.description: Placeholder rates for the public desk. Move to Estate when the fleet stops fitting a single node.
landing.plans.studio.name: Studio
landing.plans.studio.description: One panel, a handful of boxes, invoices that close on time.
landing.plans.operator.name: Operator
landing.plans.operator.description: The desk for hosts past their first node and first support hire.
landing.plans.estate.name: Estate
landing.plans.estate.description: Fleet billing, SSO, and an SLA for the hosts who never sleep.
landing.testimonials.title: Hosts who already closed the books.
landing.testimonials.description: Not a composite CEO. Operators who invoice real Pterodactyl allocations.
landing.testimonials.0.quote: We used to reconcile Pterodactyl allocations in a spreadsheet every Friday. Fluxo closed March before I opened Slack.
landing.testimonials.0.name: Mara Chen
landing.testimonials.1.quote: Staff can suspend a Rust wipe box without touching Wings. Billing just follows the power state—that used to be a two-hour page.
landing.testimonials.1.name: Diego Alvarez
landing.testimonials.2.quote: Plugin hooks let us sell extra backups without forking the panel. That is why we left the WHMCS stack we had been patching since 2019.
landing.testimonials.2.name: Priya Nair
landing.cta.title: Stand up billing before the next wipe weekend.
landing.cta.body: Connect Pterodactyl, import allocations, and send the first invoice from the same desk you use to power the node.
footer.tagline: Billing panel and Pterodactyl game-server hosting for operators who invoice real usage, not guesswork.
footer.copyright: © {year} Fluxo. Ledger for the machines that stay online.
